title: 第1379章 接连噩耗第1378章 圣尊破封
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：九龙吞天诀第1379章接连噩耗（..la）“必须得阻止他，否则就完了。”
上官尊皇急声说道。
虽然没有人攻打神柱了，可是一位圣尊级的强者复苏，面对摇摇欲坠的封印，还是有希望破开的。
“可是我们要怎么阻止呢？那可是圣尊级强者啊！”
一位老怪面色凝重。
“想办法去修复神柱，用神柱的力量去压制那圣族圣尊。”
林炎说道。
“修复神柱，谈何容易？”
众人皆是面色灰暗，这神柱可是红瑶圣尊留下来的，属于是超脱级的手段。
他们根本就不懂超脱级别强者的神文，又如何去修复神柱呢？
“将你们的修为借给我，我有办法去修复神柱。”
林炎道。
他所谓的办法自然是用暗天矛去修复。
暗天矛的本源和红瑶圣尊的力量相通。
虽然暗天矛不会布置这个级别的阵纹，但是修复一下还是没问题的。
“好。”
上官尊皇点头。
一行人立刻动手，来到了神柱附近。
而后林炎将暗天矛悬于身前，修为灌入暗天矛之中。
暗天矛射出一缕神光。

落在了神柱之上，那原本爬满裂纹的神柱，竟然一点点的融合。
所有人立刻灌入修为，上官尊皇低喝一声，将修为打入林炎的体内。
其他人，比如古阳剑尊等老怪，足有数位圣君九重的强者，还有多位圣君七重的强者一同发力。
如此海量的力量，如同洪流一般，林炎的身躯都有一种承受不住的感觉。
“啊啊啊——”
林炎忍不住身体颤抖。
“林炎，你能否承受得住？”
上官尊皇神色担忧。
数位圣君九重，哪怕不是要来灭杀林炎，只是灌输力量，也是很可怕的。
林炎毕竟修为太弱了，只有元海境八重而已。
“我能扛得住！”
“不用管我！”
林炎低吼一声，从体内走出了九大分身。
这九大分身一同结印，将林炎承受的力量分散开来，而后又汇入到暗天矛之中。
由九大分身一同分担，林炎承受的痛苦稍微小了点，可也依旧让身躯爬满裂纹，看起来十分的凶险。
虽然在场众人没有一个是圣尊级别的存在，都只是圣君，甚至元海剑客。
在这般源源不断的修复之下，那神柱上的裂纹也是迅速愈合着。
而原本要破封而出的那位圣族圣君，直接被压制了回去。
“该死的蝼蚁们，竟然敢阻挡本尊冲关！”
神柱背后的那道时空之门中，传来了一道低沉的嘶吼。

虽然隔着无垠的虚空，隔着无穷的阵法，可那一声嘶吼依旧如同九天神雷一般，令得在场众人五雷轰顶。
“噗噗噗——”
上官尊皇等几位圣君九重，皆是脑海震荡、口鼻喷血、气息危殆，遭受到了不小的冲击。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 1379 of Nine Dragons Swallowing the Heavens: Continuous Bad News (..la) "He must be stopped, otherwise it will be over."
Shangguan Zunhuang said urgently.
Although no one attacks the divine pillar, there is still hope for a saint-level strong man to recover and break the crumbling seal.
"But how are we going to stop it? That's a saint-level powerhouse!"
An old monster looked solemn.
"Find a way to repair the divine pillar, and use the power of the divine pillar to suppress the saint of the holy race."
Lin Yan said.
"Repairing the divine pillar is easier said than done?"
Everyone looked gloomy. This divine pillar was left behind by Saint Hongyao, and it was a transcendental method.
They don't understand the divine inscriptions of transcendent level experts at all, so how can they repair the divine pillar?
"Lend me your cultivation, and I will have a way to repair the divine pillar."
Lin Yan said.
His so-called method was naturally to use the Dark Sky Spear to repair it.
The origin of the Dark Sky Spear is connected with the power of Saint Hongyao.
Although the Dark Sky Spear will not arrange formation patterns of this level, it is still no problem to repair it.
"Okay."
Shangguan Zunhuang nodded.
The group of people immediately took action and came to the vicinity of the divine pillar.
Then Lin Yan hung the Dark Sky Spear in front of him, and poured his cultivation into the Dark Sky Spear.
The dark sky spear shot out a ray of divine light.
After landing on the divine pillar, the divine pillar, which was originally full of cracks, actually merged bit by bit.
Everyone immediately poured in their cultivation power. Shangguan Zunhuang gave a low shout and injected the cultivation power into Lin Yan's body.
Others, such as Guyang Jianzun and other old monsters, had several strong men at the ninth level of the Saint King, and many strong men at the seventh level of the Saint King working together.
Such a massive amount of power was like a torrent, and Lin Yan's body felt like it couldn't bear it.
"Ahhhh——"
Lin Yan couldn't help but tremble.
"Lin Yan, can you bear it?"
Shangguan Zunhuang looked worried.
Even if the ninth-level Saint Lords are not here to kill Lin Yan, but are just instilling power, they are still very scary.
After all, Lin Yan's cultivation level is too weak, only the eighth level of Yuan Hai Realm.
"I can handle it!"
"Don't worry about me!"
Lin Yan roared and walked out of the nine clones from his body.
These nine clones formed seals together, spreading the power that Lin Yan endured, and then merged it into the Dark Sky Spear.
With the nine clones sharing the pain, Lin Yan suffered a little less pain, but his body was still covered in cracks and looked very dangerous.
Although none of the people present were at the Saint Lord level, they were all just Saint Lords, or even Yuanhai swordsmen.
Under such continuous repairs, the cracks on the divine pillar also healed quickly.
And the Holy Lord of the Holy Clan who was about to break the seal was directly suppressed back.
"Damn ants, how dare you stop me from passing the level!"
A low roar came from the gate of time and space behind the divine pillar.
Although separated by the boundless void and endless formations, that roar was still like the Nine Heavens Divine Thunder, causing everyone present to be struck by thunder.
"Puff puff puff——"
Shangguan Zunhuang and several other ninth-level Saint Lords were all suffering from severe shock, with their minds trembling, blood spurting from their mouths and noses, and their breaths in critical condition.
